OrbWin bundled Alpine maintenance image

Image: docker.io/library/alpine:3.21@sha256:bbfcd601d7cd20d35bb0b8b866ad1a8a0d107ca3e1c20870c75c5ce2c1186d30
Archive SHA-256: 4a785a3d0998a81d8f0bf2d4d2949bc4905b54170bd20fd4d17707525de392cf

The upstream image is unmodified. OrbWin removes image-name metadata from its
transport archive and loads it by immutable digest. No upstream program is
executed while collecting these sources or notices.

Package-specific license/copyright texts are in LICENSE/. SOURCE-INVENTORY.json
records the image packages, exact aports revisions and checked input hashes.
SOURCES.tar.gz accompanies this notice and contains upstream source archives,
aports recipes/patches/configuration and this notice inventory. Its paths and
outer tar modes/timestamps are normalized; enclosed upstream archives are verbatim.
Use the recorded Alpine abuild recipes/toolchain for the target linux/amd64.
An identical binary rebuild or a complete historical build-tool inventory has
not been demonstrated. utmps/skalibs source contexts at the BusyBox recipe's
revision are included because that recipe explicitly requests static libraries.

Standard MIT/MPL texts are supplementary. MIT template placeholders have not
been replaced with invented authors or used to replace original copyright
notices. Component/source notices and package-declared licenses are preserved.
No separate copyright notices occur in the included Alpine signing-key data;
their recipe and declared MIT license are retained verbatim. System compiler
and ordinary build tools are not bundled here. Individual source files may have
additional notices; their complete archives and patches remain available below.
